# Reference: DPC4-ChampSim/replacement/mockingjay, single-core build. Sizes are for
# the DPC4 LLC, 4096 x 12: INF_RD 95, INF_ETR 11, MAX_RD 73, 11-bit signatures,
# 32 sampled sets. The multi-core build folds the core id instead of the hit bit,
# inserts an unknown signature at INF_ETR, and scales prefetch samples by less.
name: mockingjay
doc: >
  Mockingjay: each line holds an estimated time to reuse (ETR), counted down every
  8 accesses to its set; the victim is the line with the largest |ETR|, an overdue
  (negative) one on ties. A predictor table keyed by the hit-or-miss PC signature
  gives the ETR on insertion, and a fill predicted to be reused after every line in
  the set is bypassed. A sampled shadow cache on 32 sets measures reuse distances
  with an 8-bit per-set clock and trains the predictor one step at a time; entries
  older than INF_RD train it up as scans. Writebacks are inserted at -INF_ETR and
  train nothing.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

# the DPC4 LLC, 4096 x 12: INF_RD 95, INF_ETR 11, MAX_RD 73, 11-bit signatures,
# 32 sampled sets. The multi-core build folds the core id instead of the hit bit,
# inserts an unknown signature at INF_ETR, and scales prefetch samples by less.
name: mockingjay_rdp_min_diff_8
doc: >
  Reduced the min_diff for RDP table training from 16 to 8. This makes the predictor
  more sensitive to changes in reuse distance, aiming to improve accuracy of bypass
  decisions and reduce wrong_bypass errors.
state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 8} # Changed from 16
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 8} # Changed from 16
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

  means: >
    Reads the sample value, s, which is an age or state field. The table's maximum value, max_val, is read from its declaration.
    Computes the target value as T = min(s * scale, max_val).
    If the table entry at the index is absent, its value is set to T.
    Otherwise, its current value V is read, and the new value is set to (V * 7 + T) / 8, using integer division.

# the DPC4 LLC, 4096 x 12: INF_RD 95, INF_ETR 11, MAX_RD 73, 11-bit signatures,
# 32 sampled sets. The multi-core build folds the core id instead of the hit bit,
# inserts an unknown signature at INF_ETR, and scales prefetch samples by less.
name: mockingjay
doc: >
  Mockingjay: each line holds an estimated time to reuse (ETR), counted down every
  8 accesses to its set; the victim is the line with the largest |ETR|, an overdue
  (negative) one on ties. A predictor table keyed by the hit-or-miss PC signature
  gives the ETR on insertion, and a fill predicted to be reused after every line in
  the set is bypassed. A sampled shadow cache on 32 sets measures reuse distances
  with an 8-bit per-set clock and trains the predictor one step at a time; entries
  older than INF_RD train it up as scans. Writebacks are inserted at -INF_ETR and
  train nothing.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; wraps by design
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:                # the incoming line is predicted to be reused after every resident
    - {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
    - {table_exceeds_victim: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true            # too old to be a reuse distance; the sweep detrains it
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: toward, sample: age, min_diff: 16}
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # mockingjay.cc access(): the update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

  Reverts the detrimental changes of the previous attempt (4-bit set_clock and
  timestamp) and restores the successful architecture of top-performing designs.
  The performance decline was likely due to inaccurate reuse distance prediction
  from the reduced clock width. This version reverts to an 8-bit clock for the
  sampler, enabling accurate RDP training. It also restores sampler tag_bits to 10.
  ETR assignment in the 'access' procedure is reverted to the proven rule-based
  sequence from top designs, ensuring aggressive eviction of low-confidence lines
  and using a confidence-adjusted ETR calculation as a fallback.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; reverted to 8 bits for accuracy
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10              # Reverted to 10 for better accuracy
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO} # Reverted to 8 bits
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}} # Threshold adjusted for 8-bit age
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48} # Thresholds adjusted for 8-bit age
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48} # Thresholds adjusted for 8-bit age
        free: true
    sweep:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}} # Threshold adjusted for 8-bit age
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}} # Threshold adjusted for 8-bit age
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace:
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Aggressively evict lines with zero confidence, a proven heuristic
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # Handle absent RDP entries or those with very high RDP
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    # For all other lines, calculate ETR using a new unified cost function
    - set:
        etr:
          etr_with_confidence_cost:
            rdp_table: rdp
            conf_table: rdp_conf
            index: pc_sig
            div: 8
            scale: 2
            max_etr: 11

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

- name: deconfident_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
  means: 'Reads ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An absent rdp_val
    is treated as 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized, and its maximum value is 3. Calculates
    an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val) * scale). If the result of the subtraction
    is negative, it is treated as 0. Calculates a predicted_etr value as adjusted_rdp divided by div,
    using integer division. Returns true if predicted_etr is greater than the absolute value of the victim
    way''s key.'
- name: deconfident_rdp_gt
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
    threshold:
      int: [0, 127]
  means: 'Reads the value ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An
    absent entry in rdp_table is treated as a value of 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized,
    and its maximum value is 3. Calculates an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val)
    * scale). If the result of the subtraction is negative, it is treated as 0. Returns true if this adjusted_rdp
    is greater than the threshold.

    '
- name: etr_with_confidence_cost
  place: value
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    max_etr:
      int: [0, 15]
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. An absent 'conf_val' is treated as 0.
    The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    Calculates a base_etr = rdp_val / div using integer division.
    Calculates a penalty = (3 - conf_val) * scale.
    The final returned value is min(max_etr, base_etr + penalty).
- name: train_sampler_match
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    conf_thresh:
      int: [0, 127]
    index: signature
    min_diff:
      int: [0, 127]
    rdp_table: table
    sample: state
    scale:
      int: [1, 2]
  means: >
    Performs training for a sampler match based on the reuse distance 'sample' (age).
    First, it trains the rdp_table using the 'toward' operation. The target value is min(sample * scale, rdp_table.max). The entry moves one step toward the target if the difference from the target is at least min_diff.
    Second, if the 'sample' value is less than conf_thresh, it increments the conf_table entry at the same index.

  architecture of the top-performing candidate. The previous attempt had inverted

  This version re-adopts the proven `train_sampler_match` logic to correctly train
  confidence, and uses `etr_with_confidence_cost` to create a unified, confidence-aware
  value function for both eviction and bypass, aiming to restore and improve performance.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Retain the conservative bypass logic from the parent design
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO}
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match:
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true

        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}

    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}

on_fill:

    using integer division. Returns true if predicted_etr is greater than the absolute value of the victim
    way''s key.'

    and its maximum value is 3. Calculates an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val)
    * scale). If the result of the subtraction is negative, it is treated as 0. Returns true if this adjusted_rdp
    is greater than the threshold.

  place: value
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    max_etr:
      int: [0, 15]
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
  means: >
    Reads 'rdp_val' from rdp_table[index] and 'conf_val' from conf_table[index].
    An absent 'rdp_val' is treated as 0. An absent 'conf_val' is treated as 0.
    The maximum value for confidence is 3.
    Calculates a base_etr = rdp_val / div using integer division.
    Calculates a penalty = (3 - conf_val) * scale.
    The final returned value is min(max_etr, base_etr + penalty).
- name: train_sampler_match
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    conf_thresh:
      int: [0, 127]
    index: signature
    min_diff:
      int: [0, 127]

  Reverts the disastrous changes of the previous attempt (crippled 4-bit clock) and
  restores the successful architecture of top-performing designs. The previous attempt's
  performance collapsed due to inaccurate reuse distance prediction. This version reverts
  to an 8-bit clock for the sampler, enabling accurate RDP training. It uses a 2-bit
  confidence table and a rule-based ETR assignment that aggressively evicts low-confidence
  lines, a proven strategy from earlier successful candidates.

state:
  - name: etr
    scope: per_line
    kind: signed
    width: 5                  # holds -11..11
    init: 0
  - name: etr_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 4
    init: 8                   # GRANULARITY: the first access to a set ages it
  - name: set_clock
    scope: per_set
    kind: counter
    width: 8                  # TIMESTAMP_BITS; reverted to 8 bits for accuracy
    init: ZERO

victim:
  key: etr
  extremum: max_magnitude
  tie_break: prefer_negative
  on_search: none
  bypass_when:
    # Confidence-adjusted bypass conditions from top-performing designs
    - deconfident_rdp_gt: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, threshold: 73, scale: 4}
    - deconfident_exceeds_victim: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, div: 8, scale: 4}

signatures:
  - name: pc_sig
    source: ip
    fold: [hit, prefetch]
    hash: crc3
    low_bits: 11

tables:
  - name: rdp
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 7
    max: 95                   # INF_RD
    unset: true
  - name: rdp_conf
    scope: global
    kind: saturating
    entries: 2048
    width: 2
    init: ZERO

samplers:
  - name: sampled_cache
    scope: global
    sets: {mirror: 32}
    extra_index_bits: 4       # 16 sampler sets per sampled set
    ways: 5
    tag_bits: 10
    fields:
      - {name: signature, kind: counter, width: 11, init: ZERO}
      - {name: timestamp, kind: counter, width: 8, init: ZERO} # Reverted to 8 bits
    age: {clock: set_clock, stamp: timestamp}
    victim: {key: age, extremum: max, tie_break: first, prefer_free: true}
    on_match: # Adopted from top-performing design
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        stop: true
      - when: {type_in: [PREFETCH]}
        train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 2, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
        stop: true
      - train_sampler_match: {rdp_table: rdp, conf_table: rdp_conf, index: signature, sample: age, scale: 1, min_diff: 16, conf_thresh: 48}
        free: true
    sweep: # Adopted from top-performing design
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - when: {counter: {counter: age, cmp: gt, threshold: 95}}
        train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
        free: true
    on_replace: # Adopted from top-performing design
      - train: {table: rdp, index: signature, op: increment}
      - train: {table: rdp_conf, index: signature, op: decrement}
    install: {signature: {signature: pc_sig}, timestamp: {read: set_clock}}
    after:
      - set: {set_clock: {add: 1}}

procedures:
  access:                     # The update body shared by hits and fills
    - sample: sampled_cache
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      each_way:
        except_touched: true
        when: {counter: {counter: etr, cmp: lt, threshold: 11, abs: true}}
        set: {etr: {add: -1}}
    - when: {counter: {counter: etr_clock, cmp: eq, threshold: 8}}
      set: {etr_clock: {const: 0}}
    - set: {etr_clock: {add: 1}}
    # Reverted to rule-based ETR assignment from top designs
    - when: {table: {table: rdp_conf, index: pc_sig, cmp: eq, threshold: 0}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: absent}}
      set: {etr: {const: 0}}
      stop: true
    - when: {table: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, cmp: gt, threshold: 73}}
      set: {etr: {const: 11}}
      stop: true
    - set: {etr: {table: rdp, index: pc_sig, div: 8}}

on_hit:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    stop: true
  - run: access

on_fill:
  - when: {type_in: [WRITE]}
    set: {etr: {const: -11}}
    stop: true
  - run: access

- name: deconfident_exceeds_victim
  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    div:
      int: [1, 128]
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:
      int: [0, 16]
  means: 'Reads ''rdp_val'' from rdp_table[index] and ''conf_val'' from conf_table[index]. An absent rdp_val
    is treated as 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized, and its maximum value is 3. Calculates
    an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val) * scale). If the result of the subtraction
    is negative, it is treated as 0. Calculates a predicted_etr value as adjusted_rdp divided by div,
    using integer division. Returns true if predicted_etr is greater than the absolute value of the victim
    way''s key.'

  place: condition
  params:
    conf_table: table
    index: signature
    rdp_table: table
    scale:

      int: [0, 127]

    absent entry in rdp_table is treated as a value of 0. The conf_table is assumed to be fully initialized,
    and its maximum value is 3. Calculates an adjusted rdp value: adjusted_rdp = rdp_val - ((3 - conf_val)
    * scale). If the result of the subtraction is negative, it is treated as 0. Returns true if this adjusted_rdp
    is greater than the threshold.

    '
- name: train_sampler_match
  place: step
  params:
    conf_table: table
    conf_thresh:
      int: [0, 127]
    index: signature
    min_diff:
      int: [0, 127]
    rdp_table: table
    sample: state
    scale:
      int: [1, 2]
  means: >
    Performs training for a sampler match based on the reuse distance 'sample' (age).
    First, it trains the rdp_table using the 'toward' operation. The target value is min(sample * scale, rdp_table.max). The entry moves one step toward the target if the difference from the target is at least min_diff.
    Second, if the 'sample' value is less than conf_thresh, it increments the conf_table entry at the same index.
